page.title: GranaWiz — Personal finances that stay on your computer
page.description: Desktop, offline, and free software to manage your finances. No cloud, no subscription, no registration. macOS, Windows, and Linux.

hero.title:
Your finances,
your way.
hero.subtitle: GranaWiz is a desktop app that lives on your computer — not in the cloud. No sign-up, no subscription, no sending your data anywhere. You open it, use it, done.
hero.dashboardAlt: Screenshot of the GranaWiz dashboard showing total balance, period cash flow, and expenses by category

1.title: Stays on your drive
1.desc: Your data never leaves your computer. No server, no "sync", no backup you didn't ask for.

2.title: No subscription
2.desc: No monthly fee, no premium plan, no locked feature waiting for you to pay. Download it, use it — it's yours.

3.title: No registration
3.desc: We don't ask for your email. Or ID. Or investor profile. There's no account to create and no password to forget.

manifesto.label: The difference
manifesto.quote: Most financial tools were made to capture you — not to help you.
manifesto.p1: They want your email, your ID, your bank statement, your attention and — of course — your money as a monthly subscription. In return, they offer nice dashboards, notifications you ignore, and the constant feeling that you should be doing more.
manifesto.p2: GranaWiz is different. It runs on your Mac, PC, or Linux. No internet needed. Doesn't send anything to any server. No terms of use that change from time to time.
manifesto.p3: Your data stays on your computer. Only yours. That's not a technical detail — it's a philosophical choice about who owns your financial information.

features.label: What it does
features.title:
Financial control
without becoming a data analyst.
features.sub: Clean interface, no jargon. Each feature exists because it solves a real problem — not because it would look good on a slide.

accounts.title: Bank accounts
accounts.desc: Checking, savings, and credit card. Balance updated automatically as you record entries.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.desc: Income, expenses, and transfers with date, amount, category, tags, payer, and payee.

scheduling.title: Scheduling
scheduling.desc: Set up fixed or recurring entries so you never forget that electricity bill on the 12th.

categories.title: Categories & tags
categories.desc: Organized your way. Categorize by what makes sense for your life, not what the app imposes.

payees.title: Payers & payees
payees.desc: History of who pays you and who you pay — with totals and patterns over time.

import.title: Statement import
import.desc: CSV and OFX — the formats most banks export. Import, review, categorize.

dashboard.title: Consolidated dashboard
dashboard.desc: Total balance, monthly flow, spending pace, net worth. What matters, without noise.

theme.title: Light & dark theme
theme.desc: Work with the light you prefer — daytime, midnight, or with the lights off.

multiplatform.title: Multi-platform
multiplatform.desc: One installer per system. macOS, Windows, Linux. Same app, same experience.

spotlight.label: Import
spotlight.title:
From your bank statement
to your cash flow.
spotlight.desc: Drag the CSV or OFX your bank exports. GranaWiz reads it, shows each line, and you decide category and tag before saving — nothing enters without you seeing it.

personas.label: For who
personas.title:
For those tired
of spreadsheets and SaaS.

freelancer.title: The freelancer
freelancer.desc: Gets irregular income and needs to know, before taking on a project or making a big purchase, how much is actually available.

exSpreadsheet.title: The ex-spreadsheet user
exSpreadsheet.desc: Already tried spreadsheets — created formulas, formatted cells, gave up in week three — and wants something that simply works, no maintenance.

homeWorker.title: The remote worker
homeWorker.desc: Has more than one income source, or simply wants to stop reaching the end of the month without understanding where the money went.

privacy.title: The privacy-conscious
privacy.desc: Doesn't want their spending patterns to become training data for financial product recommendation models.

promises.label: The contract
promises.title:
What GranaWiz does not do —
and what it does.

noEmail.title: Doesn't ask for your email
noEmail.desc: No ID, no investor profile, no credit card "just to unlock the trial".

runsNow.title: Runs immediately
runsNow.desc: Installed, opened, created your first account. No eight-screen onboarding.

noAds.title: No ads
noAds.desc: No hidden premium plan. No locked feature waiting for an upgrade.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.desc: On a plane, at a cabin, in an office with spotty Wi-Fi. Works the same.

noCloud.title: Doesn't sync to cloud
noCloud.desc: Your data lives in a file on your drive. You decide what to do with it.

imports.title: Imports CSV and OFX
imports.desc: From major banks. Without needing to connect credentials anywhere.

tech.label: Built with care
tech.title:
Not a weekend project.
A deliberate decision.
tech.desc: GranaWiz is developed in Kotlin with Compose Desktop — the same stack that powers modern production apps. The choice to be local and offline was not a technical limitation. It was a decision about what kind of tool is worth building: one that serves the user, not the developer.
tech.quote: "An independent project, built by a single creator, growing feature by feature — making each part well done before adding the next."
tech.author: — Felipe Gandra, creator of GranaWiz

download.label: Download
download.title:
Available now,
for free.
download.sub: No registration. No card. No "free for 14 days". Download, install, use.

mac.desc: Runs on macOS 11 Big Sur or later. Universal binary.

win.desc: Windows 10 or 11. No admin permission required after installation.

linux.desc: For Debian-based distributions: Ubuntu, Linux Mint, Pop!_OS, and others.

finalCta.title:
This is how
it should be.
finalCta.desc: An app that opens, does what it promises, and leaves you alone. GranaWiz is ready.
